notes.title: Update 0.4 - The Garrison District

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Are Now Available For Monstrous Liberation!
notes.notes:
We've been able to add Steam Trading Cards to Monstrous Liberation! If you don't know how this works, trading cards are a Steam inventory item you can earn by playing the game. You earn a couple at random, and can trade with other Steam users to complete your set.

Completing a set of trading cards allows you to earn badges which you can display on your profile! Collecting the set multiple times allows you to upgrade your badge. Each time you earn or upgrade a badge, you also gain a number of other community items at random, such as emotes and profile backgrounds!

So if you've ever wanted to deck out your profile with Monstrous Liberation bling, now's your chance!

notes.title: Monstrous Liberation is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Here we are, game number two. Thanks to the amount of support we received from you guys on our first title, [i][b]Opportunity: A Sugar Baby Story[/b][/i], we've been fortunate enough to be able to keep making games, and this time we're aiming to do something a bit more grand in scope and scale. We're very excited to be at the start of this journey with you guys!

Otherwise, we hope you guys enjoy this initial Early Access launch of [i][b]Monstrous Liberation[/b][/i]! As a reminder, future updates will be free, so if you lock in now, you'll be getting a ton of new content, regularly, as it's ready! We'll be keeping an eye on the forums and Discord to get feedback from you guys, but also feel free to leave a review to let us, and others, know what you think about the game!
